interactDialogue.text: Could really do with a clean. But today is NOT the day.
Just checking it's all locked up.
Better lock this.
Little extra security couldn't hurt
What... the *ACTUAL* F-U-C-K...
These are a tripping hazard, I should move them out of the way before it comes back to bite me on the ass.
I could've sworn I put my phone in here before my shift - my boss is pretty strict about those things.
I don't even know why I still have this old thing lying around, I never use it.
krrrrr -- shhhhhhhiiiirrrrr --- *static noises* -- - *faint voices*...
Art is so therapeutic. I made this last year, and I couldn't be more proud of it.
Nothing interesting on, ugh.
I usually eat my dinner here. But it's been a long day... maybe I deserve a treat?
All my knives are... missing. That's not good.
Put it in the oven, and set the timer. Easy-peezy ;)
Lasagne, oh lasagne, where art thou? Ah, there! Time to put you in the oven.
Forgot I left that washing up in there, I should probably do that soon. But it's been *such* a long day already.
Gotta brush those pearly whites -       ew, why did I say that.
I'm so tired - why can't I just sleep!? I'm sure I left some pills in here.
I really should shower tonight - it's been a long (and sweaty) day.
Keepin' my towels nice and toasty 'eh?
*honk shoo*...                 *honk shoo*...          *honk-*
Dusty-ahh.
It's a bit hot in here, maybe I should open the window to let some air in.
Where I usually do my coursework. Not today Satan.
'You're not supposed to die tonight'... comforting, I guess.
5 variations of the same shirt. Love it. Plenty of room in here -- could make it 10 variations.
Best game, no debate.
It's locked.
Double locked.
9 - 9 - 9 ---  *click* -- - brrrrrrrrrrr
I don't have time for this, my dinner is getting cold. Cold lasagna is so not the vibe.
It's definitely not in here. I'll sort it out in the morning, I can't deal with this tonight.
If I don't hurry up and take my dinner out of the oven, it's going to be burnt to a crisp!
Shiiit it's not connecting-
Yes! There's a knife left in here! I knew *not* doing the washing up would have its merits!
I could hide in here, better decide quickly though.
Finally time to go to bed?
Idiots, why do they ALWAYS hide under the bed, it's *so* OBVIOUS!
It's still not connecting - has the line been... cut?
The sooner I put my dinner on, the sooner I can collapse into bed.
Nothing of use in here, I cleaned it all up earlier.
Mmmmmm, smells good.
My phone clearly isn't here, c'mon I'm wasting time!
A glass of water is what I need, I'm basically d-y-i-n-g of dehydration right now.
I'm so tired I can't even see straight. Surely this can wait until tomorrow.
God who showered in here, a gorilla? There's water everywhere! Oh wait - 'twas me. hehe.
I could crawl under here and hide?
Classic hiding spot, if I squish right to the back no one will find me.
-huh!? Oh, I fell asleep on the couch, damn. Bloody horror movie must have woken me up.
-huh!? I fell asleep on the couch, damn. Wonder what woke me up...
Reports are coming in that a dangerous convict has escaped from the nearby county detention center. Police urge everyone to lock all doors and be extra cautious until he is apprehended.

storyDialogue.text: Home, finally. God I'm so tired - but I have that lasagne for dinner, I should go put it in the oven.
It's been such a long day. I just want to collapse into bed as soon as possible.
I have some time to kill while dinner is cooking.
That's the timer on the oven. Better go get my dinner out before it burns!
Man, it's dark out here. Good thing I don't have to walk too far to get to my apartment.
Hey, sorry for making you jump. Can I borrow some money for a taxi? I'd be ever so grateful.
Thank you, oh thank you. I wish the best for your future, for good actions will always be rewarded...
Seriously!? It's only a few coins, I'm desperate -- ugh, whatever...
The consequences of your actions will come back around, and then maybe you'll think twice about the way you treat people.
